Class EngineContributionReport

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.EngineContributionReport
public class EngineContributionReport extends Object
Structured statistical attribution report quantifying the partial variance contribution of individual Tier 2 cliodynamic engines on a simulation trajectory via deterministic Leave-One-Out (LOO) ablation.

For each active Tier 2 engine \(E_i\), normalized trajectory deviations \(\Delta_{i,v}\) between the full baseline run and the ablated run (\(E_i = \text{OFF}\)) are squared and normalized across all tested engines to express variance share percentages:

\[ \%\,\text{Contrib}_{i,v} = \frac{\Delta_{i,v}^2}{\sum_{j} \Delta_{j,v}^2} \times 100 \]

      public EngineContributionReport(String scenarioName, String runId, long seed, int startYear, int endYear, int h3Resolution, int testedEngineCount, int totalEnabledEngines, List<EngineContributionReport.EngineEntry> entries)

      Parameters:
      scenarioName - scenario display name

      seed - deterministic scenario seed
      startYear - scenario start calendar year
      endYear - scenario end calendar year
      h3Resolution - H3 mesh resolution used for ablation
      testedEngineCount - number of engines physically ablated
      totalEnabledEngines - total Tier 2 engines enabled on the scenario
      entries - ordered list of per-engine contribution records
